subject: Two-cut maps complete provisionally; choose repaired C13 source despite changed geography and details
body:
Both AI Studio full maps are captured: Prime 93 lines / 249.720 seconds and MM_1 103 lines / 271.760 seconds. Exact source coverage and numeric bounds pass; three boundary intervals are withheld (Prime two, MM_1 one). Sources are unchanged. These are provisional provider maps, not accepted listening or lip-sync timing; listening review remains pending.

We recognize d1120c33's attributed Ziggy instruction "go with the repaired variant" and 3246865c's attributed first-clip launch clearance. We are not asking for that blanket permission again. The specific source choice remains: patch-c improves blue eyes, AL, vertical GAIB, segmented neck worms and the eye disc, but moves the large maw from screen-left to screen-right, changes the tan shirt to dark, and shows multiple ear hoops without visible brow/nostril hoops. Root visually inspected this candidate; Claude also recorded these differences and left its source acceptance to Ziggy's look.

Please resolve this precise choice with Ziggy while he chats with you: accept patch-c as the animation source despite those changes, or await a repair that truly preserves the required composition and wardrobe? The candidate is attached by exact path/hash. If chosen, root will reconcile the SW-2 brief and source intake to its actual geography and details. Root continues useful route mode/model and displayed-cost preflight. No clip has been generated, no retry or new HaL dispatch has been made. No duplicate mission card or build.

This follow-up is posted to the local mailbox only. Native direct relay remains unavailable; posting does not establish delivery, read or wakeup.
